hooks.name: i18n Sync — Mirror New Keys to Simplified Chinese

action.prompt:
The file `src/app/i18n/en.ts` was just saved. Compare it against `src/app/i18n/zh-CN.ts` and identify any keys that are present in `en.ts` but missing from `zh-CN.ts`, as well as any keys whose English values have changed since the last sync.

For every such key:
1. Add the key to `zh-CN.ts` with a natural Simplified Chinese translation that reads well for undergraduate EE students (not a literal word-for-word render).
2. Preserve the haunted / playful-spooky tone of the Circuit Séance UI where the English copy has that tone.
3. Keep the key order in `zh-CN.ts` identical to the key order in `en.ts`.
4. Do not remove keys from `zh-CN.ts` that still exist in `en.ts`.
5. Do not modify any other files.

If the two files are already in sync, do nothing and stay silent.
